thread:
maya: Starting canary rollout for runtime v2.1.4 -> 10% traffic to canary pool. tagging kernels: new-int8-tiling. watching p50/p95 and token throughput. :rocket:
perf-bot: [automated] Canary metrics snapshot: p50 +2ms, p95 +18%, tail CPU utilization +12% -> https://perf.company/reports/1738504321 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ash: @maya seeing the same on staging p100 — p95 jumped from 84ms -> 100ms on short sequences. not seeing correctness issues. :eyes:
raul: can we bisect which merge caused kernel selection changes? last kernel selector refactor merged yesterday (PR #1227).
kai: quick profile shows a hotspot in kernel_dispatcher when batch sizes are small. KV cache miss rate up ~6% for chat workloads. suspect heuristic that chose small-batch kernel for certain seq-len distribution.
dena: If this is a regression we should pause the canary at 10% until root cause. auto-rollback threshold currently p95 >= baseline * 1.15 for 5m. we're at ~1.18 for the last 10m.
maya: pausing rollout now. @sre can you confirm rollback policy?
sre: Confirmed. Canary controller will flip to rollback if the rolling 5m p95 breaching grace period > 3 windows. Current config excerpt: 
```yaml
canary: 
  targets: 10%
  metrics:
    - name: p95_ms
      threshold_multiplier: 1.15
      window_sec: 60
      fail_windows: 3
  automatic_rollback: true
```
ash: CI perf job caught something earlier this morning: `ci/perf/runtime-kernels` failed on synthetic microbench with +22% p95 after merging #1227 -> https://ci.company/jobs/6789 :warning:
perf-bot: CI regression collector: related tests failing: kernel_selector_perf, batching_heuristics_smoke. regression created by commit 8f3c2b9.
raul: can someone run a quick bisect locally? if commit 8f3c2b9 toggled kernel preference order that's our culprit.
kai: I pulled the commit and repro'd locally. The selector change added a rule: prefer tiled_int8 for seq_len <= 64 even when batch<4. That looks bad for chat prefixes where batch==1. simple fix: add a batch threshold before preferring tiled_int8.
dena: Proposed patch: revert selector ordering and add explicit gating config `min_batch_for_tiled_int8: 4`. Should we do hotfix or revert whole PR?
maya: prefer minimal hotfix to unblock canary and run A/B with new gating config. we want to avoid full revert unless hotfix fails.
ash: I'll open a quick PR with the gating flag and unit tests. will also add an e2e perf check in CI for batch=1/seq<=64. PR in flight: #1245
perf-bot: Canary controller: rollout paused at 10%. automatic rollback has not triggered yet (need 3 consecutive windows).
sre: note: we should also add a canary guard that checks KV cache miss rate delta > 5% as a secondary signal. current policy only watches latency. otherwise we get noisy latency deltas from cache behavior.
kai: good call. KV miss + kernel mismatch explains increased per-token CPU and latency. I'll add metric export for kv_miss_rate to the canary dashboards.
raul: also add a temporary A/B experiment: route 50% of canary traffic to fallback kernel (legacy_int8) and 50% to new selector so we can compare. low-risk.
dena: I'll coordinate with infra to create the A/B split in the rollout config.
maya: timeline: PR #1245 lands in next 30m -> patch rollout to canary 10% with A/B split -> observe for 20m -> if p95 < 1.12x baseline and kv_miss delta < 3% we proceed to 30%.
ash: PR opened: #1245 now. patch includes `min_batch_for_tiled_int8: 4` and CI perf guard for batch=1.
perf-bot: CI triggered for #1245: running perf suite. ETA ~12m. :hourglass: link: https://ci.company/jobs/6792
kai: if CI passes, I'll push hotfix image with both selector fix and a temporary fallback flag.
raul: if CI fails we revert kernel-selector changes entirely (PR #1227 revert).
maya: thanks all. keep updates in this thread. tagging @sre @perf-bot for automated alerts. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: CI for #1245 green. perf diff p95 for batch=1/seq<=64: -3% vs baseline (good).
nash: hotfix deployed to canary with A/B split. early numbers (5m): fallback path p95 baseline, new-selector path p95 +1%. overall canary p95 now +6% (under 1.15 threshold).
dena: unpause gradual rollout to 30%?
sre: wait 15 more minutes to ensure no reinstated tail. current rolling windows look stable.
maya: agreed. holding until 1738507321 for final decision.
raul: note for postmortem: add a perf gate in PR review checklist for kernel selector changes + require bench results for batch=1 chat workloads.
maya: added — thanks. rolling update will continue after hold window. :white_check_mark:
